texts.li: Once {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} got onto the subject of home, neither of them wanted to stop.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} about the worst year of {A_possessive} life, and {B_nameDef} listened to all of it.
Comparing the worst jobs they had ever had, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} lost track of the time.
{B_nameDef} asked how {A_nameDef} had learned to swim, and the answer turned into the story of {A_possessive} whole childhood.
{A_nameDef} had a long, cheerful argument with {B_nameDef} about nothing that mattered.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about what they would do with a whole year of peace, down to the house and the garden.
{A_nameDef} muttered a remark about the last meal, and {B_nameDef} laughed so hard {B_pronoun} had to sit down.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have a joke between them now, and one word of it is enough to set them both off.
{A_nameDef} did an impression of the council in session, and {B_nameDef} laughed until {B_pronoun} cried.
A dry remark from {A_nameDef} caught {B_nameDef} with a mouthful of water, and most of it ended up on the floor.
{A_nameDef} has a name for the noise {A_possessive} knees make, and {B_nameDef} can't hear it without grinning.
{A_nameDef} caught {B_nameDef}'s eye at the worst possible moment, and they both had to look away.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} the one about the muffalo and the priest, and {B_nameDef} made {A_objective} tell it again.
{B_nameDef} found {B_possessive} boots full of sand and swore revenge on {A_nameDef}, laughing.
{A_nameDef} sewed the sleeves of {B_nameDef}'s shirt shut, and both were laughing before {B_nameDef} got an arm through.
{A_nameDef} swapped {B_nameDef}'s salt for sugar, and {B_nameDef} ate the whole bowl rather than give {A_objective} the satisfaction.
{A_nameDef} slipped a beetle into {B_nameDef}'s pocket, and {B_nameDef} is already working out how to pay {A_objective} back.
As a joke, {A_nameDef} hid {B_nameDef}'s tools, and {B_nameDef} lost half a day looking for them.
{A_nameDef} put a dead rat in {B_nameDef}'s bed for a laugh, and {B_nameDef} has stopped speaking to {A_objective}.
{A_nameDef} salted {B_nameDef}'s drink, and {B_nameDef} swallowed half of it before {B_pronoun} noticed.
{A_nameDef} hid {B_nameDef}'s clothes while {B_pronoun} was washing, and {B_nameDef} had to walk back wrapped in a sack.
{B_nameDef} said hello, and {A_nameDef} turned and walked off without answering.
When {B_nameDef} came over, {A_nameDef} suddenly found somewhere else to be.
{A_nameDef} thanked the others by name for their help and left {B_nameDef} out.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} a plain question and got a shrug and a turned back for an answer.
{A_nameDef} looked straight through {B_nameDef}, as if {B_pronoun} weren't there at all.
{A_nameDef} said it was {B_nameDef}'s turn to clean up, {B_nameDef} said it wasn't, and the mess stayed where it was.
{A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} to put the tools back where they belong, and {B_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} to do it {A_objective}self.
Mud had been tracked indoors, and {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued over it, each pointing at the other's boots.
{A_nameDef} blamed {B_nameDef} for leaving the door open, and neither of them went to shut it.
{A_nameDef} swept {A_possessive} half of the floor and left a neat line of dust where {B_nameDef}'s half began.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} fell out over the hauling and started keeping a tally of who had carried what.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} went over the last fight again, from the first warning to the moment it was over.
Neither {A_nameDef} nor {B_nameDef} would give way on which of them had stood closer to the enemy in the last fight.
With both hands, {A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} where the attackers had come from, and {B_nameDef} corrected {A_objective} twice.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about a moment from the last fight that neither of them has told anyone else.
{A_nameDef} gave {B_nameDef} a lesson in {SKILL}, and by the end {B_nameDef} had the knack of it.
{B_nameDef} made the same mistake in {SKILL} three times, and {A_nameDef} explained it three different ways.
{A_nameDef} set {B_nameDef} a task in {SKILL}, watched without a word, and nodded once at the end.
Step by step, {A_nameDef} talked {B_nameDef} through the finer points of {SKILL}, then stood back and let {B_objective} try.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} the same question about {SKILL} for the third time and got the same patient answer.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} an old trick in {SKILL}, one {A_pronoun} had learned the hard way.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} turned the hauling into a race, and {A_nameDef} won it by a single load.
{A_nameDef} beat {B_nameDef} at arm-wrestling and then at cards, and {B_nameDef} demanded a rematch at both.
{A_nameDef} challenged {B_nameDef} to see who could work longer without a rest, and won, barely.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} threw stones at a post to settle who had the better arm, and {A_nameDef} won by a hand's width.
{A_nameDef} beat {B_nameDef} at dice three times running, and {B_nameDef} has started checking the dice.
{A_nameDef} carved {B_nameDef} a small figure out of scrap wood, and {B_nameDef} put it straight in {B_possessive} pocket.
{A_nameDef} painted {B_nameDef}'s name on a scrap of board, with flowers round the edge.
From nothing but {B_nameDef}'s description, {A_nameDef} painted {B_possessive} old home and got the roof exactly right.
{A_nameDef} carved {B_nameDef} a wooden bird no bigger than a thumb.
{A_nameDef} drew {B_nameDef}'s portrait in charcoal on a flat stone, and {B_nameDef} wrapped it in a cloth so it wouldn't smudge.
{A_nameDef} has been repeating what {B_nameDef} mumbles in {B_possessive} sleep, and {B_nameDef} found out.
{A_nameDef} has been passing round a theory about where {B_nameDef} really came from, and {B_nameDef} has just heard it.
{B_nameDef} overheard {A_nameDef} doing {B_possessive} accent behind {B_possessive} back.
Word got back to {B_nameDef} that {A_nameDef} has been telling the others {B_pronoun} never washes.
{A_nameDef} has a story about why {B_nameDef} left {B_possessive} last home, and it gets worse each time {B_nameDef} hears it.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} ended up working side by side and, without meaning to, started talking like people.
{A_nameDef} took the other end of a heavy load for {B_nameDef}, and neither of them said anything sharp.
{A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} how {B_pronoun} was keeping, and actually waited for the answer.
{A_nameDef} laughed at one of {B_nameDef}'s jokes, and {B_nameDef} looked almost pleased.
{B_nameDef} stumbled, and {A_nameDef} caught {B_possessive} arm instead of laughing.
{B_nameDef} took half the blame for {A_nameDef}'s burnt meal, though {B_pronoun} had been nowhere near the cooking.
{B_nameDef} let it be known that anyone with a problem with {A_nameDef} had a problem with {B_objective} too.
{B_nameDef} said out loud that {A_nameDef} had done more than {A_possessive} share lately, and looked round in case anyone disagreed.
When someone made a crack about {A_nameDef}, {B_nameDef} stared at the speaker until the apology came.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} built a fort out of whatever they could drag together, with a rule that no grown-ups may enter.
A beetle turned up, and {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued at length over what to name it.
{A_nameDef} raced {B_nameDef} until they were both too out of breath to argue about who had won.
The hole {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have started will go all the way through the world, they say.
In their game of council, {A_nameDef} turned down every single thing {B_nameDef} asked for.
Out of sticks and string, {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} made a whole family and gave each one a name.
A passing remark of {B_nameDef}'s gave {A_nameDef} an idea, and {A_nameDef} can't put it down.
{B_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} an idle question, and the answer turned into a plan while {A_nameDef} was still giving it.
{A_nameDef} watched {B_nameDef} work for a minute and saw how to fix something {A_pronoun} had been stuck on for weeks.
